title: Animal Community Cat Nuisance
description: Complaints involving community cats, including sanitation and noise concerns.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a community cat nuisance.
actions.why: Report a complaint involving community cats, including sanitation or noise concerns. This service addresses nuisance complaints rather than requests for spay/neuter surgery or vaccinations.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Animal Care and Control" > Choose "Animal Community Cat Nuisance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Animal Care and Control" > Choose "Animal Community Cat Nuisance"
